bitfield.description: Buffer Pointer Low: Data buffer's base address pointer, lower 32 bits.Typically read-only for the USB controller's DMA [HW]. However, HW can be made to overwrite the pointer with an incoming [8-byte] SETUP packet, by setting the 64-bit pointer to its own address [i.e. that of PARAM_LO].

Buffer Pointer High: Data buffer's base address pointer, upper 32 bits.Typically read-only for the USB controller's DMA [HW]. However, HW can be made to overwrite the pointer with an incoming [8-byte] SETUP packet, by setting the 64-bit pointer to its own address [i.e. that of PARAM_LO].

register.description: This regiaster indicates TRB Status, Packet Count and Buffer Size.

bitfield.description: TRB Status. Updated by HW transfer status information before releasing the TRB.
Packet Count Minus1:Total number of packets in the Buffer Descriptor, minus 1, for High-Speed, High Bandwidth isochronous IN endpoints, in an Isoc-First TRB.
Buffer Size. Remaining size [to be sent / which can be received] in TRB's data buffer, in bytes. Decremented by HW after data is transferred.

register.description: This register indicates Transfer Control, Interrupt Control and Stream ID.

bitfield.description: Stream ID / SOF Number. Stream-based bulk EP: The Stream ID of the transfer.Isochronous EP: [micro]frame number in which the last packet of the buffer was transmitted [debug].
Interrupt on Complete. Applicable only when LST=0, for a] IN EP or b] OUT EP when CSP=1.Read-only for the USB controller's DMA [HW].
Interrupt on Short Packet / Interrupt on Missed ISOC. Controls the generation of the XferInProgress event. Read-only for the USB controller's DMA [HW].
TRB Control. Type of TRB.Read-only for the USB controller's DMA [HW].
Continue on Short Packet. Reaction of an OUT endpoint upon reception of a short packet.Read-only for the USB controller's DMA [HW].
Chain Buffers. Associates this TRB with the next in the same Buffer Descriptor. Always 0 in the last TRB of a Buffer Descriptor.Read-only for the USB controller's DMA [HW].
Last TRB. Indicates the last TRB in a list, i.e. in a transfer for the endpoint / bulk-stream. Read-only for the USB controller's DMA [HW].
Hardware Owner. TRB ownership. Set to 1 by SW when creating the TRB. SW cannot modify the TRB again until cleared to 0 by HW. There are exceptions for short packets on OUT endpoints and Link TRBs.
